title: deparia omeiensis
intro: Deparia omeiensis, commonly known as Japanese golden-Back fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in East Asian medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and cough. The therapeutic actions of Deparia omeiensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-viral activities. The bioactive constituents of Deparia omeiensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
